q_001.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM bank_accounts WHERE region = 'Prague';

q_002.sql:
SELECT SUM(approved_amount) AS total_approved_amount
FROM loans
WHERE contract_status = 'finished'
  AND payment_status = 'fully_paid'
  AND (problem_flag = FALSE OR problem_flag = 0);

q_003.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS owner_count FROM disposition WHERE authorized_user = FALSE;

q_004.sql: SELECT AVG(monthly_payment) AS average_monthly_payment FROM loans;

q_005.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_client_count
FROM clients c
WHERE c.gender = 'Female'
  AND c.district_id IN (
    SELECT s.district_id
    FROM salaries s
    GROUP BY s.district_id
    HAVING AVG(s.salary) > 10000
  );

q_006.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ao.client_id) AS distinct_client_count
FROM account_owners ao
JOIN accounts a ON ao.account_id = a.id
WHERE a.region = 'Prague';

q_007.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM transactions WHERE account_id = 1 AND transaction_date >= '1997-01-01' AND transaction_date < '1998-01-01';

q_008.sql:
SELECT d.district_name AS district, COUNT(DISTINCT a.owner_id) AS owner_count
FROM accounts a
JOIN districts d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.region_name = 'South Moravia'
GROUP BY d.district_name
ORDER BY owner_count DESC;

q_009.sql:
SELECT c.client_id,
       c.gender,
       SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount
FROM   clients c
JOIN   accounts a ON a.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN   loans l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE  a.owner_status = 'owner'   -- adjust the value/column name as needed
GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender
ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

q_010.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS contract_count
FROM loan_contracts lc
JOIN accounts a ON lc.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE lc.status = 'running'
  AND lc.standing = 'good'
  AND c.gender = 'Male'
  AND r.name = 'North Bohemia';
